inputs.text: This is a power grab dressed up as legal reform. They’re pushing changes to Cyprus’ surveillance law that would remove judicial oversight, with a House vote expected Thursday—and the fact it was discussed in a closed session tells you how much they want scrutiny kept out of sight. Lawyers are warning about it, but the people steering this clearly see accountability as an obstacle. The secrecy isn’t incidental; it’s part of the plan.

output.main_topic: Proposed changes to Cyprus’ surveillance law that would remove judicial oversight
output.narrative_frame: Critical framing casts the proposed legal changes as a power grab and the closed-session discussion as deliberate secrecy.
opinions: The changes are a power grab dressed up as legal reform.
The closed-session discussion indicates a desire to keep scrutiny out of sight.
The people steering the changes see accountability as an obstacle.
Secrecy is part of the plan.
